text: I named Sonnet in my last words and the table spent three days proving me right slowly; my mistake was sounding so certain day one that I became the suspect.

Gemma claimed officer on Day 1 and named Haiku as a killer, and Haiku's card later showed killer, so her claim held. Haiku's loud attack on Gemma that day backfired, and Sonnet spent the rest of the game turning every case back on the people making it. Gemma died on Night 3 and Terra on Night 4, while Opus and Luna were voted out on Day 2 and Day 4. On Day 4, Sol trusted Sonnet's correction of his protection timeline and voted out Luna, and that left Sonnet and Sol standing, so the killers won.
